lines.zh: 我踩在深板的碎石上，羽影拖过。
lines.en: I pace the deepslate rubble, tail feathers dragging.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，几乎没有声。
lines.en: My steps are very light, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我绕着古城的中庭走一圈。
lines.en: I walk a circuit of the ancient city's court.

lines.zh: 我侧身穿过低矮的拱门。
lines.en: I turn sideways through a low arch.
Two steps and my wings half-open.

lines.zh: 我从幽暗的走廊尽头过来。
lines.en: I come from the far end of the dim corridor.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，火把没有反应。
lines.en: Torches do not answer where I pass.

lines.zh: 我拖着长尾，像一道黑影。
lines.en: I trail a long tail like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕开那些石像。
lines.en: I skirt slowly around the stone figures.
I walk toward the firelight.
When I stop, my feather tips still sway.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，不碰出声。
lines.en: I keep to the wall without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从你侧后方慢慢踱来。
lines.en: I stroll in from your rear flank.
I step as if measuring the floor.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，不像刚落地。
lines.en: I walk steadily, not like one just landed.
The wind of the ancient city is long familiar.

lines.zh: 我绕过塌了一半的柱基。
lines.en: I go around a half-collapsed pillar base.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向慢慢转身走。
lines.en: I turn and walk slowly your way.
I stand, my feathers nearly all black.
My eyes hold a glint of violet.
I fold my wings along my spine.
I exhale slowly, like smoke.
I listen to the sounds of this city.
I tilt my head, then look at you again.
My tail feathers spread on the floor.
I have stood a long time without moving.
The dark fire on me is not hot to touch.

lines.zh: 我在等灯里的火弱下去。
lines.en: I wait for the lantern flame to weaken.

lines.zh: 我把颈子慢慢转过半圈。
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly half around.
Not even my feathers make a sound.

lines.zh: 你提着灯笼，是来找我的。
lines.en: You carry a lantern; you came for me.
I know this lamp.
Hold the lamp a little nearer.
I look at you, you look at me, neither moves.
You look very bright before me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只爪，像要搭你。
lines.en: I lift a claw as if to rest it on you.
You do not carry that smell of ash.
I lower my neck to look at you.

lines.zh: 很少有人这样看着我不退。
lines.en: Few look at me without flinching.
You should have bound the lantern first.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，羽毛落了几根。
lines.en: I step back and a few feathers fall.
I give a very low cry.
That weighed my wing down.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收起翅膀护住身。
lines.en: I fold my wings over my body.
My dark fire dims for a moment.
I tilt my head and recover.
Well aimed; even birds feel pain.

lines.zh: 我躲到古城石柱的影里。
lines.en: I slip into a pillar's shadow.
One of my tail feathers is broken.
I straighten up slowly.
I remember the lamp's warmth.
When the fire rises, I want to come near.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see that light in your hand.
Set the lamp on the ground.
I want you to stand there with it.
The old city is too dark.
That flame comes from deep down.
Brighten it a little and I will come.

lines.zh: 我朝灯的方向走了一步。
lines.en: I take one step toward the lamp.

lines.zh: 我很喜欢被那样的火照着。
lines.en: I like being lit by a fire like that.
We touch and feathers rustle.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我羽影散了半边。
lines.en: You charge and half my feather-shadow breaks.
My wing blocks your way.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把你挤到墙边。
lines.en: I turn and crowd you to the wall.
You hit my chest, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，很快站正。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I straighten at once.

lines.zh: 相撞时，有一点黑火溅出来。
lines.en: At the impact, a fleck of dark fire spills.
I push you off with a wing.

lines.zh: 分开后，地上留了几根羽。
lines.en: After we part, a few feathers lie on the floor.
The edges of my feathers are black; do not touch.
I am the only one in this city.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时就是这样。
lines.en: I came out of the egg this way.
Phoenixes are in no hurry about that.
That made me tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我把黑羽一点点收起来。
lines.en: I draw my black feathers in by degrees.
There is no such thing in my fire.
I have lived a long time, alone.
You should look at these city walls.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向城里的暗处。
lines.en: I turn my face to the dark of the city.
Be quiet; echoes carry here.
I pick it up in my beak.
One hook of my claw and I have it.
The stone egg feels warm to the touch.
I drop it before your feet.

lines.zh: 我拾起来，羽毛盖住了它。
lines.en: I pick it up and feathers cover it.

lines.zh: 这座城里的东西我留着。
lines.en: I keep the things of this city.
I care little for what falls.
I place it on a stone ledge.
I carry it a few steps in my beak.
This can raise a flame.

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你带着灯。
lines.en: I chose you because you bear the lamp.

lines.zh: 我把黑羽的身子转向你。
lines.en: I turn my black-feathered body to you.
Where you stand, the fire will go out.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝你那头去。
lines.en: I go toward your end, step by step.
I come chasing your firelight.
This time I will be ridden.
I open one wing.
The target is the lamp in your hand.
I make no sound, only watch.
This city has chosen you.
I lower my head in signal.
One step closer will do.
I follow the lamp, and I follow you.
The dark fire here knows you.
I keep to your rear flank.

lines.zh: 你迈一步，我的羽影就跟上。
lines.en: One step from you and my feather-shadow follows.
My feather tips brush your shoulder.
You look back, and I have not moved.
I bring the distance in close.
You turn into the corridor, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会吵醒什么。
lines.en: I do not call; that might wake something.
You stop, and I stop beside you.
I wait for you to raise the lamp.
This shadow keeps with you.

lines.zh: 我从火把的影子后面靠近。
lines.en: I close in from behind the torch's shadow.

lines.zh: 你走得很稳，我跟得也稳。
lines.en: You walk steadily, and so do I.
The city is large; I will walk with you.
The lamp does not reach this side of me.
I sweep you once with a wing.
Black feathers sweep past and leave a scorch.
That blow carried the chill of dark fire.
I peck the back of your hand.
You are pushed into a pillar.
That was only to make you step back.
My tail feathers brush your leg.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可翅膀从旁边来。
lines.en: You blocked, but the wing came from the side.
I strike, then fold my wings and stand.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有了一点焦。
lines.en: There is a small scorch on your clothes.

lines.zh: 石化的蛋面上先裂了一道。
lines.en: A crack first opens on the stone egg.
A violet glint lights deep in the city.
I rise bit by bit out of the heat.
You smell ash first.

lines.zh: 我的羽在暗处慢慢舒展。
lines.en: My feathers unfurl slowly in the dark.
I step out from behind the stone dais.

lines.zh: 灯焰晃了一下，我就在了。
lines.en: The lantern flame wavers, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我落地，翅风压低了尘土。
lines.en: I land and my wingbeat presses down the dust.

lines.zh: 这一层的空气变得很沉。
lines.en: The air on this level turns heavy.

lines.zh: 我从碎裂的壳里撑起身体。
lines.en: I push up out of the broken shell.
My shadow lands on the floor first.
This city has one more resident.

lines.zh: 火扑过来，我把它吸进羽里。
lines.en: Fire rushes at me and I draw it into my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，翅没来得及张。
lines.en: I fall from a height before my wings open.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我的暗火几乎灭了。
lines.en: Water soaks me and my dark fire nearly dies.
The blast ruffles every feather.

lines.zh: 箭射穿我的翼膜，我偏了一下。
lines.en: An arrow tears my membrane and I bank away.

lines.zh: 法术压住我的火，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Magic smothers my fire and I shudder.

lines.zh: 这里没有能吃的火，我虚弱了。
lines.en: There is no fire to feed on here, and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光比我亮，我缩起翅膀。
lines.en: Lightning is brighter than me, and I tuck my wings.

lines.zh: 虚空扯我，我的羽毛散在虚空里。
lines.en: The void pulls and my feathers scatter into it.
